entries.interpretation: Lookup treats 0x34 as a length when ID 9900 is requested; the pointer coincides with the end of message 1927, so independent allocation versus subsequent data overlap is not established.

limitations: Target source ownership and why index ordering differs are unverified.
Comparisons cover this message class only and do not validate consumer substitution structures.
Reference executable uses a provisional historical build configuration.
The meaning of binary message 9900 is unknown; length-prefixed bytes are recorded without assuming text or source ownership.
ID 9900 points exactly at the end of preceding message 1927; its nominal 52-byte text may overlap following structured data. Do not treat the bytes as a proven independent immutable message.
